text:
oliver: FYI staging restores intermittently failing to decrypt snapshot metadata; kms.Decrypt AccessDenied ~1/20 attempts.
emma: paste the error lines?
oliver: encops-bot: [2026-03-10T14:12:22Z] restore-job 4821 error: kms.Decrypt AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::111:assumed-role/restore-agent is not authorized to use the key (kms:Decrypt) status code: 403, request id: 9c1f-...
emma: sounds like ephemeral grant TTL expiration. These snapshots use HSM CMKs and a KMS-proxy issuing per-request ephemeral grants.
sre_jun: any RBAC changes to restore-agent role this week?
oliver: none; last RBAC work was backup-uploader two weeks ago. No restore-service deploys.
todd: canary changed proxy grant TTL from 60s -> 30s last night to reduce live grants. Could race with slower restores.
amy: if grant TTL < time between issuance and actual decrypt, AccessDenied expected. Options: extend TTL or add renew flow in restore-agent. Also need better audit fields (grant_id, issued_at, ttl, proxy_req).
emma: short-term fix: bump TTL to 90s for HSM CMKs on restore path. Long-term: restore-agent should auto-renew on AccessDenied with grant-expired.
security-qa: marking P2 for vuln triage. Is this exploit or availability? If attacker can force decrypt delays, risk DoS.
oliver: availability now, but found backup-uploader variant that writes decrypted metadata to /tmp before upload in a rare retry branch. Investigating.
encops-bot: [2026-03-10T14:28:10Z] vuln-tracker created: UPLOAD-TMP-PLAIN-122 uploader may leave plaintext in /tmp under certain retries.
emma: repro snippet attached. If uploader crashes after decrypt and before cleanup, temp file persists.
sre_jun: patch: use O_TMPFILE or open+unlink pattern to avoid on-disk plaintext; container OS support caveats.
todd: also tighten IAM: deny direct kms:Decrypt for uploader role in prod; require decrypt via enclave-proxy with ephemeral grants.
amy: audit schema proposal: enrich KMS events with grant_id, grant_issued_at, grant_ttl_s, proxy_request_id. Example: {"event":"kms_decrypt","key_id":"arn:aws:kms:...","principal":"restore-agent","result":"AccessDenied","grant_id":"g-abc123","grant_issued_at":"2026-03-10T14:11:45Z","grant_ttl_s":"30","proxy_req":"p-789"}
security-qa: that helps correlate expired-grant failures.
oliver: incident playbook: 1) emergency bump proxy TTL to 120s for HSM CMKs; 2) run canary 100 serial decrypts from restore-agent in staging; 3) patch uploader to O_TMPFILE and canary deploy; 4) add audit fields + alert when repeated AccessDenied with same grant_id; 5) postmortem within 48h.
emma: opening PRs for TTL change (infra/proxy), uploader tmpfile fix (backup/uploader), and audit schema (observability).
encops-bot: [2026-03-10T14:45:02Z] ticket UPLOAD-TMP-PLAIN-122 created and assigned to emma.
sre_jun: canary script for staging: for i in {1..100}; do aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://meta.enc --key-id arn:... || echo "fail $i"; sleep 0.5; done. Run after TTL change and report fails.
amy: policy change: create allowlist of services that can request ephemeral grants for HSM CMKs; deny direct kms:Decrypt for uploader role in prod.
oliver: also request audit retention extension to 90 days (was 30) for these events for compliance.
todd: coordinating with logging infra; ETA for TTL bump 20m if oncall approves.
amy: @sre-oncall can you approve temporary TTL rollback? low blast radius.
sre-oncall: approved temporary TTL increase to 120s for key aliases alias/staging/restore and alias/prod/restore for 20m window. Monitor metrics.
oliver: running canary now.
encops-bot: [2026-03-10T14:58:30Z] canary result: 0 fails in 100 decrypts after TTL bump.
emma: great. Next: uploader tmpfile fix PR pinned to canary.
oliver: tagging legal for potential data exposure review due to /tmp issue.
amy: follow-ups: add runbook entry under encops-runbooks "ephemeral-grant-decrypt-failure" with commands, audit queries, and RBAC checklist.
emma: will draft runbook and link PRs.
sre_jun: note long-running restores > TTL (network/backpressure) need renew logic in agent.
oliver: adding backlog item: implement grant_renew on AccessDenied with exponential backoff.
encops-bot: [2026-03-10T15:12:01Z] incident UPLOAD-TMP-PLAIN-122 status: mitigated (canary pass); follow-ups created.
amy: milestone: close when tmpfile fix + audit schema + RBAC allowlist merged and prod canary passes.
emma: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
